name: Daniel "unicornFurnace" Crowley
biography: (@dan_crowley) (aka "unicornFurnace") is a Managing Consultant for Trustwave's SpiderLabs team. Daniel denies all allegations regarding unicorn smuggling and questions your character for even suggesting it. Daniel has developed configurable testbeds such as SQLol and XMLmao for training and research regarding specific vulnerabilities. Daniel enjoys climbing large rocks. Daniel has been working in the information security industry since 2004 and is a frequent speaker at conferences including DEF CON, Shmoocon, and SOURCE. Daniel does his own charcuterie.
